# Version 4.159.0 (Unreleased)
> **Image comparison and rendering refinements**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.159.0 introduces an experimental image-comparison package for testing rendered output. The upcoming release also refines Ganesh texture-edge sampling and Tizen CPU blur selection. Linux x86 native assets are no longer included.

## Breaking Changes

- **Move Linux x86 deployments to a supported architecture** — Linux x86 native assets are no longer built or included in NuGet packages. Applications relying on those assets must move to a supported architecture before upgrading. ([#5784](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5784))

## API Surface

- **Experimental image-comparison package** — SkiaSharp.Testing adds SKImageComparison for SKImage, SKBitmap and SKPixmap, with channel tolerances, masks, mismatch budgets and error-magnitude gates. Comparisons default to exact unpremultiplied RGBA. The assembly is experimental; opt in by suppressing diagnostic SKIA4001 with NoWarn or a pragma. ([#5293](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5293))
- **Reusable comparison diagnostics** — Generate binary masks, channel differences, threshold maps, overlays and heatmaps to investigate image mismatches. Comparison results retain no native handles; returned difference images are independent SKImage instances that callers must dispose. ([#5293](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5293))

## Bug Fixes

- **Safer Ganesh texture-edge sampling** — Filtered sampling clamps slightly inside texture subsets to avoid including undefined exterior texels. Ganesh texture-edge pixels may change; this does not change CPU or Graphite rendering. ([#5679](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5679))
- **Tizen CPU blur selection applied correctly** — Tizen now applies its intended blur configuration to Skia itself, selecting the existing ThreeBoxApprox/Tent paths instead of the shader-based Gaussian candidate. Blur output and performance may differ; Tizen rendering and performance were not measured locally for this change. ([#5679](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5679))
